headline: Shree Renuka Sugars announces change in company secretary and compliance officer

headline: Sugar producer shares fall up to 6 percent amid growth concerns
hook: Sugar stocks tumble on growth concerns

headline: Government forms committee to address sugar sector issues
hook: Sugar industry policies under government review
summary: The Ministry of Finance has established a committee to examine challenges faced by sugarcane farmers and the sugar industry. The panel is expected to review pricing mechanisms, ethanol production incentives, and the financial health of sugar mills. This move follows industry demands for updates to the minimum selling price of sugar and export quotas. Retail investors in sugar stocks should note that committee recommendations often precede major regulatory shifts in this controlled sector.
whats_next: Submission of the committee's report and recommendations
why_it_matters: Regulatory shifts may impact sugar and ethanol stock margins
winners_losers: Farmers gain / Sugar mills face policy uncertainty

hook: Festive season demand lifts sugar shares
